description: Diamond Princess cruise ship (~2,710 passengers + ~1,100 crew = 3,810). Princess Cruises Grand-class, built 2004 by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries: 290m LOA × 37.5m beam, 115,875 GT, twin-funnel silhouette, 18 decks. 1,353 staterooms across 8 cabin decks (5, 6, 8-12, 14; no deck 13); deck 7 Promenade is all-public. Cabin-corridor resolution (44 pax + 9 crew corridors). Key venues: five main dining rooms, Promenade specialty dining, Grand Plaza atrium, Lido pools and buffet, Sun Deck spa and fitness. CDC Extra-Large AGE target 22.1/100K TD (calibration deferred). Layout follows the Princess accessible-route map and cruisedeckplans.com deck plans (2020 configuration: Kai Sushi and Savoy; the 2026 Crown Grill / Makoto Ocean rebrands are not modeled).
